name: – David McAllister – After § 76 – Am 54
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 76a. Notes that the Commission has concluded numerous free trade agreements in recent years and is currently engaged in a large number of new trade negotiations; points out that these free trade agreements are totally incompatible with the EU’s values, commitments and obligations in the fields of sustainability, social and human rights, health and agriculture; stresses that the geopolitical context should in no way be used as a justification for opening new trade negotiations and, reciprocally, that trade liberalisation is not the appropriate way to strengthen relations with third countries; calls, therefore, for the suspension of the ongoing negotiations and considers that a radical change in the EU’’s trade policy is needed in order to promote other forms of cooperation that are not aimed at the perpetual growth of trade flows and are based on solidarity, social needs and planetary limits;
